author: Myv
body:
Now, this may not seem like a lot to some people who are very good at PvP (pot and soup) and always get them, but for someone like me who uses a touchpad and rarely gets 40fps, I was rather proud of getting my 50th monument this evening.

I just wanted to mention it because I feel that some people may underestimate me and that I may be better than you first think xD.

I got all 3 monuments on Justice 3 (but there were only 5 players on xD) but my 50th monument was the Back on Justice III, and to celebrate I mined the final one with my hand (the team really were noobs lol).

Thanks for reading, and I'm sure people aren't very impressed, but for me this is quite an achievement, on Avicus anyway. I am probably one of the worst PvP'ers in history so you know xD.

iBiZa_MiNeCrAfT
